Filtered Relevant Items:
1. [18] “Steam Client連線不穩定” — Proxifier showed intermittent proxied connections closing after about 30 seconds with bytes sent but zero bytes received. The application failed while a browser using the same proxy remained functional; suggestions included checking application-specific proxy rules and forcing TCP.
2. [19] “youtube 获取不到1080p的视频” — A Proxifier connection to a content host closed with bytes sent and zero received, followed by a TLS handshake timeout.
3. [20] “VIP歌曲不能播放” — Proxifier repeatedly opened and immediately closed HTTP connections with zero bytes transferred. The logs also reported that HTTPS traffic was incorrectly sent to an HTTP proxy endpoint.

External Knowledge Summary:
- Proxifier logs showing requests sent but no response can accompany application-specific proxy failures and TLS handshake timeouts [18][19].
- Repeated zero-byte open/close cycles may indicate a proxy protocol or endpoint mismatch, such as HTTPS traffic being directed to an HTTP-only proxy [20].
- Relevant troubleshooting clues include verifying application/domain proxy rules and transport settings rather than assuming the upstream service itself is unavailable [18][20].
